title: One Raindrop Burst Into a Whole Rainbow
caption:
One grey drop just unleashed an entire rainbow
A single raindrop hovers over a grey puddle, then bursts into a rainbow splash that floods the street with colour.
Best on loop at night, watching the monochrome world slowly melt into colour.
Would you rather keep the calm grey rain or take the rainbow burst?
Save this for your next rainy scroll and follow @fruit_drama_tv for more tiny visual stories.
